tests.reason: sending an invite writes a chat message to real people, answering one joins events, and the audiobook entry is written when a member sets a reminder; staging shares the production Supabase project, so none of it is exercised there. These suites prove it with the real services over a fake PostgREST: what can be invited to, the card built on the server from the sender's own entry (forged fields ignored), who may answer, what Accept does (free event joined, paid/full event or room opens its page, own plan copied, No removes the copy), and the audiobook entry (one daily row, DST-correct start, no calendar push, a calendar failure never fails the reminder).
